name: @pps/scoring
//: DELIBERATELY EMPTY. This package is the one piece of the system that runs in all three runtimes: Node (Vercel functions), Deno (Supabase Edge Functions, where the 20MB bundle cap and 2s CPU budget leave no room for a dependency tree), and the browser (optimistic client-side re-scoring). Every import here must resolve to the JS standard library. Adding a dependency - including a type-only one - breaks the Deno and browser targets. Keep this object empty.
